newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai exporters put 1997 rice exports at 5 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Thai exporters put 1997 rice exports at 5 mln T.

text.p: Thai Rice Exporters Association expects to ship around five million tonnes of rice in 1997 compared with 5.2 million tonnes projected for 1996.
Vorapong Pichpongsa, president of the association, told Reuters that the value of the rice exports could fall this year compared with the value for last year.
Rice exports during January-November fetched about 44 billion baht in foreign exchange.
"The competition for medium and low grade rice would be very tough as our competitors such as India, Vietnam and Bangladesh can produce at a much lower cost," he said.
"But good quality rice which makes up around 40 percent of the exports would have no problem. About 40-50 percent have already been committed," he added.
He said East European countries and Iraq could be potential clients and suggested that the government help finance financially-troubled consumer countries.

"The key to maintaining competitiveness is to keep our current market share while always looking to expand to new markets. Thai private exporters are very active on that. But we do also need support from the government," he said.
